notes.title: DEMO Update Live｜Adventure Log & Stone Collection Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h3]🔍 [b]Adventure Log: Keep track of every clue![/b] ✨[/h3][p]
Based on player feedback and internal testing, we've added the Adventure Log to help you keep track of notes, discoveries, and story hints. In the full version, more entries will unlock as the story unfolds—perfect for piecing everything together![/p][p][/p][h3]🪨 [b]Stone Collection Now Available![/b] ✨[/h3][p]
In this DEMO, you can discover and collect two adorable stones—like the fluffy [i]Mangou[/i]! Each one can be viewed in full 360°. The stones are hidden throughout the map, waiting for you to find them. More to come in the full version![/p]

notes.title: The Steam Next Fest limited demo is now live!
notes.notes:
[p]
[/p][p]🎮 The [b]Steam Next Fest limited demo[/b] is now live!
[i]Always With You[/i] returns with an upgraded experience — available only from [b]June 9 to 16[/b]![/p][p]This version has been refined based on player feedback, delivering a smoother and more immersive experience.
🐱 A mysterious new cat companion also appears at the end!
You can’t interact with them yet, but we’re already looking forward to officially meeting them in the full release.[/p][p]🛒 Don’t forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] to support us!
🎁 And yes — we’re holding a [b]limited-time campaign[/b] where wishlisting the game gives you a chance to win digital gift cards! Go check it out![/p][p]Official live stream is now on! :[/p]

notes.title: The demo of "Always With You" is now available
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The demo of "Always With You" is now available on Steam~
Join Mia and Cats as they explore the mysterious Alto Civilization.
Find a relaxing afternoon and dive into the adventure with your cat!

If you have any questions, feel free to join our Discord to chat, share your thoughts, or report any bugs and feedback.

💬 Join our Discord!
